# Configuration Reference

This chapter documents all configuration files, lookup tables, and dependencies.

## Pipeline Configuration

**File:** `R/00_irs_bmf.R` (top section)

```r
# Enable checkpointing (saves intermediate results to parquet)
ENABLE_CHECKPOINTS <- TRUE
CHECKPOINT_DIR <- "data/checkpoints"

# Enable strict quality gates (stops on validation failure)
STRICT_QUALITY_GATES <- TRUE

# Processing year
PROCESSING_YEAR <- "2025"
```

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---------|------|---------|-------------|
| `ENABLE_CHECKPOINTS` | logical | TRUE | Save intermediate results after each phase |
| `CHECKPOINT_DIR` | character | "data/checkpoints" | Directory for checkpoint files |
| `STRICT_QUALITY_GATES` | logical | TRUE | Stop pipeline on validation failure |
| `PROCESSING_YEAR` | character | "2025" | Year being processed (used in file names) |

---

## Data Source Configuration

**File:** `R/config.R`

### IRS BMF URLs

```r
bmf_2025_url_ls <- list(
  northeast_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo1.csv",
  mid.atlantic_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo2.csv",
  gulf.and.pacific.coast_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo3.csv",
  international.pr_region = "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo4.csv"
)
```

| Region | File | URL |
|--------|------|-----|
| Northeast | eo1.csv | `https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo1.csv` |
| Mid-Atlantic | eo2.csv | `https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo2.csv` |
| Gulf & Pacific | eo3.csv | `https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo3.csv` |
| International/PR | eo4.csv | `https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/eo4.csv` |

### Raw File Paths

```r
bmf_2025_raw_paths <- c(
  "data/raw/bmf_2025_northeast_region.csv",
  "data/raw/bmf_2025_mid.atlantic_region.csv",
  "data/raw/bmf_2025_gulf.and.pacific.coast_region.csv",
  "data/raw/bmf_2025_international.pr_region.csv"
)
```

## Lookup Table Configuration

**File:** `R/config.R`

### CSV Lookup Tables

```r
# Paths to CSV lookup tables
subsection_classification_code_lookup_path <- "data/lookup/classification_subsection_code_lookup.csv"
affiliation_code_lookup_path <- "data/lookup/affiliation_code_lookup.csv"
deductibility_code_lookup_path <- "data/lookup/deductibility_code_lookup.csv"
foundation_code_lookup_path <- "data/lookup/foundation_code_lookup.csv"
activity_code_lookup_path <- "data/lookup/activity_code_lookup.csv"
organization_code_lookup_path <- "data/lookup/organization_code_lookup.csv"
```

### Excel Lookup Workbook

```r
lookup_path <- "data/lookup/bmf_code_lookup.xlsx"
lookup_ls <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(lookup_path) |>
  purrr::set_names() |>
  purrr::map(~ {
    df <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile = lookup_path, sheet = .x)
    data.table::setDT(df)
  })
```

**Sheets in `bmf_code_lookup.xlsx`:**

| Sheet Name | Used By | Key Column |
|------------|---------|------------|
| `status_code` | `transform_status_code()` | status_code |
| `asset_code` | `transform_asset_code()` | asset_code |
| `income_code` | `transform_income_code()` | income_code |
| `filing_requirement_code` | `transform_code()` | filing_requirement_code |
| `pf_filing_requirement_code` | `transform_code()` | pf_filing_requirement_code |
| `ntee_code` | `transform_ntee_code()` | ntee_code |
| `ntee_code_major_group` | `transform_ntee_code()` | ntee_code_major_group |
| `ntee_code_activity_type` | `transform_ntee_code()` | activity_type |
| `accounting_period` | `transform_accounting_period()` | accounting_period_code |

# Lookup Table Schemas

## affiliation_code_lookup.csv

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `affiliation_code` | integer | IRS affiliation code (1-9) |
| `affiliation_code_definition` | character | Code description |

**Values:**
```
affiliation_code,affiliation_code_definition
1,Central organization
2,Intermediate organization
3,Independent organization
6,Central organization (group ruling)
7,Intermediate organization (group ruling)
8,Central organization (no group ruling)
9,Subordinate organization (group ruling)
```

## deductibility_code_lookup.csv

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `deductibility_code` | integer | Deductibility status |
| `deductibility_code_definition` | character | Description |

## foundation_code_lookup.csv

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `foundation_code` | integer | Foundation type code |
| `foundation_code_definition` | character | Foundation type description |

## organization_code_lookup.csv

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `organization_code` | integer | Organization structure code |
| `organization_code_definition` | character | Organization type |

## activity_code_lookup.csv

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `activity_code` | character | 3-character activity code |
| `activity_code_category` | character | Activity category |
| `activity_code_definition` | character | Activity description |

## classification_subsection_code_lookup.csv

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `subsection_code` | character | IRC subsection (e.g., "03") |
| `classification_code` | character | Single-char classification |
| `classification_description` | character | Classification description |
| `exempt_organization_type` | character | Organization type name |
| `effective_start_date` | date | When code became effective |
| `effective_end_date` | date | When code was retired (if applicable) |

# Dependencies

## Required R Packages

```r
# Core data manipulation
library(data.table)     # High-performance data.table operations

# File I/O
library(arrow)          # Parquet read/write
library(openxlsx)       # Excel file reading

# String operations
library(stringr)        # String manipulation

# Date handling
library(lubridate)      # Date parsing

# Utilities
library(here)           # Project-relative paths
library(purrr)          # Functional programming

# Optional: Excel reading alternative
library(readxl)         # For organization name lookup

# Quality report rendering (optional)
library(quarto)         # Quarto document rendering
library(ggplot2)        # Visualization for quality reports
library(scales)         # Number formatting for charts
```

## Installation

```r
# Core packages
install.packages(c(
  "data.table",
  "arrow",
  "openxlsx",
  "stringr",
  "lubridate",
  "here",
  "purrr",
  "readxl"
))

# For quality report rendering (optional)
install.packages(c("quarto", "ggplot2", "scales"))
```

## Version Requirements

| Package | Minimum Version | Notes |
|---------|-----------------|-------|
| R | 4.1.0 | For native pipe `|>` |
| data.table | 1.14.0 | For `:=` and `.SD` operations |
| arrow | 10.0.0 | For Parquet support |

# Environment Variables

No environment variables are currently required. All configuration is done in R files.

## Future Considerations

For production deployment, consider:

```r
# Example .Renviron file
BMF_YEAR=2025
BMF_STRICT_MODE=TRUE
BMF_CHECKPOINT_DIR=/data/bmf/checkpoints
```

---

# Updating for New Years

When processing a new BMF year:

1. **Update config.R:**
   ```r
   PROCESSING_YEAR <- "2026"
   ```

2. **Check IRS URLs:**
   - Verify URLs haven't changed
   - Update if needed

3. **Update expected row count:**
   ```r
   # In R/quality/pre_checks.R
   BMF_2026_EXPECTED_ROWS <- <new count from IRS website>
   ```

4. **Check for schema changes:**
   - Download sample file
   - Compare columns to `BMF_REQUIRED_COLUMNS`
   - Update if IRS added/removed columns

5. **Update lookup tables:**
   - Check for new codes in IRS documentation
   - Add any new values to lookup CSVs/XLSX
